chapter.513010B66DB664B5.chapter_subtitl: Start with a hammer and Coke Oven. Coke leads to steel, creosote to treated planks; combine them with wire and a component for the first chassis. Then choose water or wind power, prepare transport and build the production machines you need.
Read top to bottom · hover a quest to see all its connections
Open a quest to inspect all prerequisites, including links to other chapters. Item tasks check inventory; the description explains assembly and a test run.

quest.5130110029567322.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × MV Wire Coil (immersiveengineering:wirecoil_electrum). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130110029567322.title: Medium-voltage wire coil
quest.513011027911756D.quest_desc: Mixer construction kit: the fixed 3×3×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Earn the native advancement Industrial Potionmaking (immersiveengineering:multiblocks/mb_mixer). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.513011027911756D.title: Industrial Potionmaking
quest.51301103F035DDAB.quest_desc: Sheetmetal Tank construction kit: the fixed 3×5×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Earn the native advancement Water Tower (immersiveengineering:multiblocks/mb_tank). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.51301103F035DDAB.title: Water Tower
quest.513011060A137580.quest_desc: A Blast Furnace Preheater accelerates the Improved Blast Furnace by supplying hot air. Place it at a designated side port; one furnace supports up to two preheaters.
Supply power to each Preheater and compare the furnace under load. The preheater does not smelt steel by itself, replace coke, or add automation to the Crude Blast Furnace.
quest.513011060A137580.title: Obtain 1 × Blast Furnace Preheater
quest.5130110BC9722D12.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Revolver (immersiveengineering:revolver). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130110BC9722D12.title: Obtain 1 × Revolver
quest.5130110C9CAE442B.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Engineer's Manual (immersiveengineering:manual). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130110C9CAE442B.quest_subtitle: Immersive Engineering recipes and structure diagrams
quest.5130110C9CAE442B.title: Obtain 1 × Engineer's Manual
quest.5130110CAA0B1890.quest_desc: A Splitting Conveyor alternates cargo between its left and right sides. It can distribute a stream across two receiving lines without electrical power.
It redirects whole item entities rather than splitting each stack in half. A single stack of 64 therefore goes to one side; feed several separate portions when testing the alternation.
quest.5130110CAA0B1890.title: Obtain 1 × Splitting Conveyor Belt
quest.51301113A3154D2A.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Engineer's Screwdriver (immersiveengineering:screwdriver). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301113A3154D2A.quest_subtitle: Coke, creosote and steel for the first chassis
quest.51301113A3154D2A.title: Obtain 1 × Engineer's Screwdriver
quest.5130111A675CD3CC.quest_desc: Assembler construction kit: the fixed 3×3×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
The Assembler performs up to three stored recipes in sequence and can use an earlier result in the next recipe. Form the structure from the manual to satisfy the quest.

For the first test, configure one recipe, put materials in the lower input slots and supply power from above. The recipe grids describe the craft rather than supply its ingredients. Fluid recipes also need filled internal tanks.
quest.5130111A675CD3CC.title: Form the Assembler
quest.5130112227C31308.quest_desc: The Kinetic Dynamo converts a Water Wheel or Windmill’s rotation into electricity. Place the dynamo first, then attach the wheel or windmill to its shaft.
Connect its energy output to a capacitor or machine and check that charge increases. A dynamo without rotation generates nothing, and an arbitrary shaft from another mod is not a supported drive.
quest.5130112227C31308.title: Obtain 1 × Kinetic Dynamo
quest.5130112C76268D3A.quest_desc: Arc Furnace construction kit: the fixed 5×5×5 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Earn the native advancement The Hottest Topic (immersiveengineering:multiblocks/mb_arcfurnace). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.5130112C76268D3A.title: The Hottest Topic
quest.5130112DAAA79EEE.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Reinforced Blast Brick (immersiveengineering:blastbrick_reinforced). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130112DAAA79EEE.title: Obtain 1 × Reinforced Blast Brick
quest.5130113060E2375A.quest_desc: The LV Capacitor stores surplus generation and supplies it during workshop demand peaks. Configure faces with the hammer: blue is input, orange is output, and an unmarked face is disabled.
Feed the blue face and connect the machine to the orange face. First verify charging without the consumer, then enable the load; the capacitor stores energy but does not generate it.
quest.5130113060E2375A.title: Obtain 1 × LV Accumulator
quest.513011306BCB6E37.quest_desc: Silo construction kit: the fixed 3×7×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Earn the native advancement Sheetmetal Stash (immersiveengineering:multiblocks/mb_silo). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.513011306BCB6E37.title: Sheetmetal Stash
quest.51301133BE177146.quest_desc: An Extracting Conveyor takes items from an adjacent inventory and sends them onto the belt. Place it beside the source chest; sneak-right-click with the hammer to change its input side.
Adjust extraction speed with the screwdriver. Send a few items into an empty receiver before increasing the flow: faster extraction cannot solve a full output.
quest.51301133BE177146.title: Obtain 1 × Extracting Conveyor Belt
quest.5130113462B5267C.quest_desc: A Conveyor Belt moves item entities without electrical power. Rotate it with the hammer and end the line at an inventory that can accept its cargo.

An ordinary belt does not extract items from a chest by itself: feed it with a hopper, machine or Extracting Conveyor. A full destination leaves items backed up outside, so check storage capacity before a long run.
quest.5130113462B5267C.title: Obtain 1 × Conveyor Belt
quest.5130113B29A18A2A.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement Booker, Catch! (immersiveengineering:tools/skyhook_distance). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.5130113B29A18A2A.title: Booker, Catch!
quest.51301140C9328072.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Engineer's Hammer (immersiveengineering:hammer). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301140C9328072.quest_subtitle: Coke, creosote and steel for the first chassis
quest.51301140C9328072.title: Obtain 1 × Engineer's Hammer
quest.5130114CEA71331A.quest_desc: A Water Wheel supplies steady rotation to a Kinetic Dynamo. Mount it on the shaft of an already placed dynamo and arrange flowing water around the wheel in a consistent direction.
Check output through capacitor charge rather than animation alone. Up to three wheels can share one shaft; an extra wheel without suitable water flow does not replace a properly arranged water route.
quest.5130114CEA71331A.title: Obtain 1 × Water Wheel
quest.5130114F2594B696.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Coal Coke (immersiveengineering:coal_coke). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130114F2594B696.quest_subtitle: Coke, creosote and steel for the first chassis
quest.5130114F2594B696.title: Obtain 1 × Coal Coke
quest.513011518B793203.quest_desc: Place two connectors of the same voltage tier and use the matching wire coil on them in sequence. An actual connection earns the advancement; carrying the coil does not.

To test power, attach a Connector to the source output and another to the consumer input. A Relay only joins wires and does not transfer energy into its supporting block. Keep the wire path clear because an obstruction breaks the connection.
quest.513011518B793203.title: Birds on a Wire
quest.5130115247ECD3E2.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × MV Accumulator (immersiveengineering:capacitor_mv). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130115247ECD3E2.title: Obtain 1 × MV Accumulator
quest.51301157FF888779.quest_desc: Coke Oven construction kit: the fixed 3×3×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.

The Coke Oven supplies coke for steelmaking and creosote for treated wood. Build a solid 3×3×3 cube of 27 Cokebricks, then use the Engineer’s Hammer on the centre block of a side. Forming the multiblock completes this task.
For the first run, insert coal and collect both products. The oven is slow and supports batches; arrange creosote extraction before scaling up, because it does not push that fluid out by itself.
quest.51301157FF888779.title: Build a Coke Oven
quest.513011585394EA3D.quest_desc: Bottling Machine construction kit: the fixed 3×3×2 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Build the Immersive Engineering Bottling Machine using the Engineer's Manual, then form it with the Engineer's Hammer. Possessing its components alone does not count.
quest.513011585394EA3D.title: Form the Bottling Machine
quest.5130115B313C6A81.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Coke Brick (immersiveengineering:cokebrick). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130115B313C6A81.quest_subtitle: Coke, creosote and steel for the first chassis
quest.5130115B313C6A81.title: Obtain 1 × Coke Brick
quest.513011647FD31AF9.quest_desc: A Windmill drives the Kinetic Dynamo without consuming fuel. Attach it to the dynamo and keep the space in front of its blades clear; a wall obstructing the airflow reduces output.

Apply Windmill Sails by right-clicking the windmill to improve it. Add a capacitor for an uneven workshop load: generation depends on conditions and does not guarantee continuous power for a large machine.
quest.513011647FD31AF9.quest_subtitle: An alternative to the Water Wheel
quest.513011647FD31AF9.title: Obtain 1 × Windmill
quest.51301167DCA596B9.quest_desc: Steel plates feed the Industrial Chassis recipe and workshop construction. Make them from finished steel; an iron plate does not replace a steel plate in this route.

Make the first plates by hand: 2 steel ingots and the Engineer’s Hammer produce 1 plate. Manually hammered iron, copper and gold plates also cost 2 ingots each. A powered Metal Press with its mold uses only 1 ingot per plate, halving the metal consumed by this operation.
quest.51301167DCA596B9.quest_subtitle: Blast Furnace steel → plates for the chassis
quest.51301167DCA596B9.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Plate
quest.513011680472300F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Buzzsaw (immersiveengineering:buzzsaw). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011680472300F.title: Obtain 1 × Buzzsaw
quest.5130116938AB4E49.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Mining Drill (immersiveengineering:drill). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130116938AB4E49.title: Obtain 1 × Mining Drill
quest.51301169A78021F0.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Steel Mechanical Component (immersiveengineering:component_steel). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301169A78021F0.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Mechanical Component
quest.5130116C6548DD6D.quest_desc: An LV Connector is an input or output for a low-voltage wire network. Attach it to an energy-capable face of a source or machine and connect it to another connector using a copper LV coil.
If the machine does not charge, check the block face and wire tier. A similar-looking Relay cannot feed the machine, and MV wire cannot connect to an LV Connector.
quest.5130116C6548DD6D.title: Obtain 1 × LV Wire Connector
quest.5130117254399ACB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Fluid Pipe (immersiveengineering:fluid_pipe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130117254399ACB.title: Obtain 4 × Fluid Pipe
quest.51301173D68FCBFF.quest_desc: Metal Press construction kit: the fixed 3×3×1 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
The Metal Press automates plates, rods and other metal parts. Build the structure shown in the Engineer’s Manual and use the hammer on its piston; formation completes the quest.

To operate it, right-click with the required mold, feed power through the top connector and send material onto the input conveyor. A formed press without a mold cannot process ingots. Give the output conveyor somewhere with free storage space to deliver them.
quest.51301173D68FCBFF.title: Pressing Matters
quest.5130117F8A73721B.quest_desc: A Vertical Conveyor lifts items straight up where an inclined belt would take too much space. Feed its lower end and provide an inventory or onward belt at the top.
Its buckets carry items, not fluids. Test the top transition with a small batch so cargo reaches the receiver instead of collecting above the lift shaft.
quest.5130117F8A73721B.title: Obtain 1 × Vertical Conveyor Belt
quest.5130117FBB68BE2D.quest_desc: Treated wood is ordinary planks impregnated with creosote from the Coke Oven. It is used in the Industrial Chassis and engineering structures, so keep the oven’s liquid by-product.

First collect creosote in a suitable container and make a small batch of planks. For continuous production, arrange extraction into a tank: the oven does not automatically push creosote into an ordinary pipe.
quest.5130117FBB68BE2D.quest_subtitle: Coke Oven creosote → planks for the chassis
quest.5130117FBB68BE2D.title: Obtain 1 × Treated Wood Planks
quest.513011829B3BAD9A.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Metal Press Mold: Gear (immersiveengineering:mold_gear). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011829B3BAD9A.title: Obtain 1 × Metal Press Mold: Gear
quest.51301192F84C0562.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × MV Wire Connector (immersiveengineering:connector_mv). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301192F84C0562.title: Obtain 1 × MV Wire Connector
quest.51301195D2829429.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × HV Accumulator (immersiveengineering:capacitor_hv). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301195D2829429.title: Obtain 1 × HV Accumulator
quest.513011965BAF66F4.quest_desc: Improved Blast Furnace construction kit: the fixed 3×4×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
The Improved Blast Furnace adds automated input and output to steelmaking. Build the reinforced-brick structure with its top hopper from the manual and form it with the hammer.
Feed iron and coke from above. Steel exits at the front and slag at the back, so provide both receivers. Up to two Preheaters attach to its side ports, but each needs an electrical supply.
quest.513011965BAF66F4.title: Next Level Blasting
quest.5130119C81CF64E3.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Chemical Thrower (immersiveengineering:chemthrower). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130119C81CF64E3.title: Obtain 1 × Chemical Thrower
quest.5130119EFCBAF93F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Accumulator Backpack (immersiveengineering:powerpack). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130119EFCBAF93F.title: Obtain 1 × Accumulator Backpack
quest.513011A503096C2F.quest_desc: A Light Engineering Block is a multiblock construction part, not a finished workstation. Its SOQM recipe uses an Industrial Chassis and Electromechanical Drive alongside mechanical components.
Choose your next structure in the Engineer’s Manual and count its materials first. This quest asks for the block in your inventory; placing a lone Light Engineering Block does not start production.
quest.513011A503096C2F.title: Obtain 1 × Light Engineering Block
quest.513011A784AC24C0.quest_desc: A Redstone Controlled Conveyor lets you stop material on part of a belt. In this version it moves without a signal and stops when powered by redstone.
Place it before the station whose input you want to control and test both states with a lever. Its signal polarity cannot be inverted with the screwdriver; it differs from multiblock redstone ports.
quest.513011A784AC24C0.title: Obtain 1 × Redstone Controlled Conveyor Belt
quest.513011A899EC23A8.quest_desc: Engineer’s Wire Cutters are used in wire-part recipes and to remove installed wiring. They let you rebuild the network without breaking the machine beneath a connector.
Right-clicking a connector with the cutters removes its connected wires. Check which branches depend on that connection first, because one junction can supply several consumers.
quest.513011A899EC23A8.quest_subtitle: Coke, creosote and steel for the first chassis
quest.513011A899EC23A8.title: Obtain 1 × Engineer's Wire Cutters
quest.513011AE9CF26AB0.quest_desc: Blast Furnace construction kit: the fixed 3×3×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
The Crude Blast Furnace turns iron into steel. Build a solid 3×3×3 cube of 27 Blast Bricks and form it with the hammer on the centre block of a side; the task detects formation.

Operation needs iron and a supported high-carbon fuel such as Coal Coke. Remove both steel and slag: a full by-product slot stops the process. This early furnace is operated manually; use the Improved Blast Furnace for automated input and output.
quest.513011AE9CF26AB0.title: Form the Blast Furnace
quest.513011B10EB819FC.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Dropping Conveyor Belt (immersiveengineering:conveyor_dropper). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B10EB819FC.title: Obtain 1 × Dropping Conveyor Belt
quest.513011B12DC6165B.quest_desc: Excavator and Bucket Wheel construction kit: the fixed 3×7×8 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Earn the native advancement Diggy Diggy Hole (immersiveengineering:multiblocks/mb_excavator). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.513011B12DC6165B.title: Diggy Diggy Hole
quest.513011B5A6A9EB2A.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Metal Press Mold: Rod (immersiveengineering:mold_rod). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B5A6A9EB2A.title: Obtain 1 × Metal Press Mold: Rod
quest.513011B5FB049CD1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Item Router (immersiveengineering:sorter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B5FB049CD1.title: Obtain 1 × Item Router
quest.513011B6D00A0F88.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × LV Wire Coil (immersiveengineering:wirecoil_copper). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B6D00A0F88.quest_subtitle: Copper wire for the chassis and power grid
quest.513011B6D00A0F88.title: Obtain 1 × LV Wire Coil
quest.513011C37B3FFEB2.quest_desc: Heavy Engineering Blocks are used in larger engineering structures and equipment. Their recipe depends on the Steel Mechanical Component, Industrial Chassis and Electromechanical Drive.

Reserve the batch needed for your chosen multiblock before spending blocks on a drill or other equipment. This quest checks the construction block; a complete machine must be assembled and formed from its own diagram.
quest.513011C37B3FFEB2.title: Obtain 1 × Heavy Engineering Block
quest.513011CA9536C271.quest_desc: Sawmill construction kit: the fixed 5×3×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
Build the Immersive Engineering Sawmill using the Engineer's Manual, then form it with the Engineer's Hammer. Possessing its components alone does not count.
quest.513011CA9536C271.title: Form the Sawmill
quest.513011D0113472B0.quest_desc: The Iron Mechanical Component is a crafting part, not a working machine. It is used in the Industrial Chassis and early Immersive Engineering devices.

Reserve the components needed for your next chassis before spending the rest on optional equipment. The steel component has different uses; a higher material tier does not make it interchangeable in recipes.
quest.513011D0113472B0.quest_subtitle: Coke, creosote and steel for the first chassis
quest.513011D0113472B0.title: Obtain 1 × Iron Mechanical Component
quest.513011D01FAD3591.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Fluid Router (immersiveengineering:fluid_sorter). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D01FAD3591.title: Obtain 1 × Fluid Router
quest.513011D0F247BDDA.quest_desc: Automated Workbench construction kit: the fixed 3×2×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.

The Automated Workbench automates products from engineering blueprints. After formation, place the required Blueprint on its table and select a result; an arbitrary 3×3 crafting grid does not replace the blueprint.

Feed materials through the blue-marked hatches and power above them; finished parts leave the conveyor end. The quest detects formation, so follow it with a real production cycle and an output receiver.
quest.513011D0F247BDDA.title: Form the Auto Workbench
quest.513011D9F9BB4662.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Railgun (immersiveengineering:railgun). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D9F9BB4662.title: Obtain 1 × Railgun
quest.513011E25267FD65.quest_desc: The plate mold selects the Metal Press’s plate-forming operation. It is piston tooling, not an ingredient to drop onto the conveyor.

Make it using the appropriate engineering blueprint, then right-click the formed press to install it. Supply matching ingots and power. Switch to the corresponding mold when you need rods or gears instead.
quest.513011E25267FD65.title: Obtain 1 × Metal Press Mold: Plate
quest.513011E6BD90E95B.quest_desc: The Fluid Pump actively extracts fluid from a tank or suitable world source. Configure input, output and blocked faces on its lower half with the hammer, then connect the output to a tank.

Its normal control requires a redstone signal; the screwdriver inverts that condition. Electrical power enables faster pumping. If creosote stays in a Coke Oven, check active extraction rather than just the presence of pipes.
quest.513011E6BD90E95B.title: Obtain 1 × Fluid Pump
quest.513011E94A1C3709.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Metal Press Mold: Wire (immersiveengineering:mold_wire). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011E94A1C3709.title: Obtain 1 × Metal Press Mold: Wire
quest.513011EA9C91377F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Steel Drill Head (immersiveengineering:drillhead_steel). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011EA9C91377F.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Drill Head
quest.513011EE444C38AF.quest_desc: Crusher construction kit: the fixed 5×3×3 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
The Crusher converts suitable solid ingredients into crushed products. Form the multiblock from the Engineer’s Manual, connect power and place an output receiver before feeding it.

The quest checks construction. Test operation by feeding one small batch through the input and collecting the main product and any by-product. Keep clear of the intake and do not send valuable items into it without a matching recipe.
quest.513011EE444C38AF.title: Hazardous Machinery
quest.513011F19F27E6F7.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Redstone Engineering Block (immersiveengineering:rs_engineering). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011F19F27E6F7.title: Obtain 1 × Redstone Engineering Block
quest.513011F3D9FACD30.quest_desc: An LV Relay creates branches and turns along wiring between distant machines. Mount it on a support and attach matching LV wires.
Keep Connectors at the source and consumer: a Relay only joins wires. Combining many consumers does not increase the current a single wire can carry; an overloaded line can burn out.
quest.513011F3D9FACD30.title: Obtain 1 × LV Wire Relay
quest.513011F8C15E22E3.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement X Marks the Spot (immersiveengineering:main/buy_oremap). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.513011F8C15E22E3.title: X Marks the Spot
quest.513011FFA590DC5D.quest_desc: Alloy Kiln construction kit: the fixed 2×2×2 layout. Tasks list every construction block and one reusable Engineer’s Hammer.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
The Alloy Kiln opens early metal mixing, including electrum and constantan. Build a 2×2×2 cube of eight Kiln Bricks and form it with the Engineer’s Hammer.

The task detects formation. Test operation separately by inserting both metals from one supported recipe and fuel, then collecting the alloy. This kiln is not a blast furnace and does not replace the steelmaking process.
quest.513011FFA590DC5D.quest_subtitle: Coke, creosote and steel for the first chassis
quest.513011FFA590DC5D.title: Form the Alloy Smelter
